description: A high-performance all-purpose cleaner (APC) designed to tackle a wide range of automotive cleaning tasks. Developed using advanced German car care technology, this powerful cleaner combines strong dirt-removal performance with excellent material compatibility, making it suitable for both interior and exterior vehicle cleaning. Its microactive surfactant formula quickly dissolves grease, oils, road grime, insect residue, and protein-based dirt from automotive surfaces while remaining safe on most materials when diluted properly. The highly concentrated formula allows flexible dilution depending on the cleaning task, making it extremely economical for professional detailers, car wash centers, workshops, and automotive enthusiasts. With one cleaner you can efficiently clean: Engine compartments Wheel arches and tires Exterior paint and trim Interior plastics and dashboards Upholstery and carpets Door panels and rubber seals The NTA-free formulation ensures strong cleaning performance while being suitable for modern car wash systems with water recycling technology. Whether used for pre-wash preparation, interior deep cleaning, or heavy degreasing, SONAX MultiStar delivers professional results with minimal effort. How to Use Dilute with water depending on contamination level. Spray onto the surface using a pump sprayer or foam cannon. Allow to work for up to 3 minutes. Agitate with brush or sponge if necessary. Rinse thoroughly or wipe with a damp microfiber cloth.
